epic.title: UI polish and alignment pass
epic.description: A presentation-only pass over every web screen. It applies one set of alignment rules: control height, spacing rhythm, tabular numerics, 44px table rows, calm error rows, centred empty states, and the mobile context row. It also fixes the specific defects in the 2026-11-06 screenshots (trace detail, dashboard, prompts/playground, settings/auth, mobile). The new rules go in a v3.2 CSS layer (traceloom/web/static/ui/*.css) loaded after app.css, split into one file per task so parallel developers never collide. Routes, data, permissions and colour tokens do not change.
